findings.location: ...Il fait froid (45 degrés ou moins le matin)....
findings.source_quote: It’s cold (45 degrees or colder in the morning).
findings.suggested_fix: Clarify the temperature unit to match the original meaning. Either indicate Fahrenheit explicitly or convert to Celsius. Example fixes (pick one) — (a) «Il fait froid (45 °F [≈7 °C] le matin).» or (b) «Il fait froid (environ 7 °C le matin).» Preserve the surrounding paragraph and HTML tags.
findings.translation_quote: Il fait froid (45 degrés ou moins le matin).

findings.location: ...Il y a des spathiphyllums, des roses, des hibiscus...
findings.source_quote: There are peace lilies, roses, hibiscus and other bright flowers blooming, and succulents growing...
findings.suggested_fix: Use the common French name for "peace lilies" or supply the botanical name parenthetically so French readers recognize the plant. Suggested wording: «Il y a des lis de la paix (spathiphyllums), des roses, des hibiscus…» or «Il y a des spathiphyllums (lis de la paix), des roses, des hibiscus…». Preserve the HTML structure.
findings.translation_quote: Il y a des spathiphyllums, des roses, des hibiscus et d'autres fleurs vives en fleur, et des succulentes qui poussent...
